source: MAFF/GIZ, "Guidelines for Banana Export from Cambodia to China" (2022), section 6
text: For exporters wanting to make direct buyer contacts in China, this guide lists several recurring trade fairs and expos relevant to fresh fruit and vegetables: the China Fresh Fruit and Vegetable Fair (China FVF, held in Beijing, listed via en.chinafvf.com), the China International Import Expo (CIIE, held in Shanghai, www.ciie.org/zbh/en), Asia Fruit Logistica (held in Singapore in September, around the 16th-18th, www.asiafruitlogistica.com), the ifresh Asia Fruit & Vegetable Industry Expo (held in Shanghai in November, around the 10th-12th, en.ifreshfair.cn), and Asia Fresh (held in Shanghai in November, around the 27th-28th, www.asiafreshexpo.com). Exact dates shift year to year, so exporters should check each event's website directly before planning travel, but this list is a useful starting point for identifying which regional trade shows are worth attending to meet Chinese fruit importers and distributors in person.
